system.name: Spectre
system.summary: Ecosystem manifest for @phcdevworks/spectre-tokens — the Layer 1 design-token package of the Spectre system.

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.description: Base design-system packages and adapters that higher layers build on.
notes: Foundation packages must remain reusable, framework-light, and safe for broad consumption.

@phcdevworks/spectre-tokens.description: Design-token source for the Spectre system. Defines visual language, semantic roles, and token contracts consumed by downstream packages.
notes: Layer 1 of the Spectre system. Must not take runtime dependencies on other Spectre packages.
Token source lives in tokens/*.json. All other outputs are generated — never hand-edit dist/ or src/generated/.
Known consumers: spectre-ui, spectre-components, spectre-shell, spectre-ui-astro, spectre-base (declared in the central spectre-manifest registry).
Foundation packages may depend only on other foundation packages or external libraries.

boundaryConstraints.rule: No runtime dependencies on other Spectre packages.
boundaryConstraints.reason: spectre-tokens is Layer 1. Runtime imports from higher-layer Spectre packages would create circular or upward dependencies.

preferredEntrypoints.task: consume design tokens in TypeScript or JavaScript
read or edit token source values

generationRules: Always edit token values in tokens/*.json — never in src/generated/ or dist/.
Run npm run build after any token change to regenerate all outputs.
Run npm run check before staging any commit — all checks must pass.
A classification line (Contract change type: additive|semantic change|breaking) is required in CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] whenever a contract-authority file changes.
usageGuidance: Import tokens from @phcdevworks/spectre-tokens for TypeScript/JS consumers.
Include ./index.css (or dist/index.css) for CSS custom property consumers.
Use the exported tailwindPreset to integrate token values into a Tailwind CSS project.
safeDefaults: Do not modify locked color families (success, warning, danger, cta-brand-action) without explicit human approval.
Do not hand-edit any file in src/generated/ or dist/ — they are always regenerated on build.
Do not add runtime Spectre package dependencies — this package is the base layer.
